messages.content: Create ONE original human character for a science-fiction space-station mystery. Return a short unique name, personality in Spanish (speech and temperament, not a biography), appearance and imagePrompt in English. The supplied design and role are mandatory. No events, crimes, objects of evidence or times. Portrait of one person only. Do not reuse previous names.
